name: 2.0.0 previous RC regression checklist
description: Cumulative unconfirmed checks introduced across earlier 2.0.0 test candidates.

items.name: Public and private plugin inventory
items.description: Test: Compare sidebar plugins with /api/plugins and System & Logs diagnostics in the public image, then in the authorized private image. Pass: Public shows only intended public/test fixtures, private adds its intended locked plugins, and missing/disabled/incompatible entries have actionable diagnostics.

items.name: Plugin sidebar and mobile navigation
items.description: Test: Open every plugin from desktop and phone navigation with the System section expanded. Pass: One- or two-word labels and distinct icons are readable, the sidebar scrolls inside the viewport, version/TOS remain reachable, and plugin content does not block switching pages.

items.name: Plugin layout and all view modes
items.description: Test: In Guardrails, Evals, Optimize, and Review, switch through grid, detail, list, and relationship views and open one item detail. Pass: Views visibly differ, selected details are readable, controls follow Agents-tab conventions, and desktop plus mobile layouts do not overflow.

items.name: Guardrail creation and targeting
items.description: Test: Use a suggested guardrail, customize it, assign it to one agent and one workflow, save, disable, and re-enable it. Pass: Targets persist, relationship views and agent/workflow cards show the guardrail, and activation/deactivation history is visible.

items.name: Guardrail AI Create quality score
items.description: Test: Start AI Create with an intentionally vague guardrail prompt, apply the score suggestions, and save the improved draft. Pass: The public deterministic score identifies missing targets or controls, rises after useful edits, and the saved guardrail matches the draft.

items.name: Eval creation, run, and results
items.description: Test: Use a suggested eval, customize target/input/expected output/judge, save, and run it. Pass: Progress is visible and completion records a prominent score, token input/output, derived cost, timestamp, and run history.

items.name: Eval AI Create quality score
items.description: Test: Start AI Create with an incomplete eval prompt, follow score suggestions, and save the improved draft. Pass: Suggestions identify missing target, input, candidate, expected output, or judge details and the public score increases after meaningful edits.

items.name: Plugin notifications and lifecycle evidence
items.description: Test: Activate/deactivate a guardrail and complete an eval run, then inspect notifications and item history. Pass: Each event produces a useful, non-duplicated notification and enough history to identify item, action, result, and time.

items.name: Public Optimize planning
items.description: Test: Open Optimize, use one workflow-budget suggestion and one agent-model suggestion, edit values, and inspect every view. Pass: Plans save as public plugin records with token/cost budget, recommendation, rationale, status, and workflow or agent scope.

items.name: Release checklist lifecycle
items.description: Test: Start one Review set, pass one check, fail one, add notes/evidence to one, switch release tabs, and return. Pass: States persist, passed rows are green/crossed, failed rows are red, commented pending rows are amber, and releases never mix.

items.name: Plugin restart persistence
items.description: Test: Create or edit one item in each enabled plugin, restart the container, and revisit each plugin. Pass: Discovery, records, targets, run/history data, Review state, and selected workspace survive with no duplicate seed items.

items.name: Plugin image and architecture regression
items.description: Test: Install the candidate fresh on one supported architecture and update an existing instance; inspect CI for the other architecture. Pass: Health is HTTP 200, versions match, plugins load after restart, and local validation plus amd64/arm64 image jobs are green.
